question: What is the relationship of the FDI percentage of gdp and economic grow in middle and low income group?
query: SELECT   AVG(CASE WHEN income_group IN ('low', 'middle') THEN fdi_pct_gdp END) AS avg_fdi_pct_gdp_low_middle,   AVG(CASE WHEN income_group IN ('low', 'middle') THEN real_economic_growt_indicator END) AS avg_real_economic_growt_indicator_low_middle FROM global_development_indicators;
